_comment: Living off the Brisering (design-return-journey.md stage 4, part 1): foraging spots, camps and cooking. All the assistant's drafts (user: foraging spots and camp sites on the Brisering; a staging area before hunts). forage: kinds of spot, where they grow (Brisering tile symbols), how many in all, what they give [item, least, most], and how long they take to grow back (Pulses). camps: one every spacing_km along each road, off to one side. recipes: cooked at a camp: what goes in, what comes out. Fish dishes (v0.100.0): fillets come from gutting a fish (g as you land it, or u on one in your pack).
